items.title: Has AI's honeymoon ended on Wall Street?
items.summary: Although the AI industry has been the darling of Wall Street for years, the sector now makes investors wince as it reckons with a wave of concerns over dizzying spending and its promise to make the technology profitable.But as spending has ballooned, so has debt -- and profits have yet to match.

items.title: Zero To Sixty: Tesla Expands Cybercab To Dallas As Waymo Pauses Freeway Operations This Week
items.summary: Tesla accelerated its robotaxi push this week with Cybercab rides in Dallas and limited personal ownership invitations this week, while rival Waymo paused freeway service after a California ban.

items.title: Data Center AI Chips Could Change the Winners: Broadcom and Marvell
items.summary: While investors fixate on Nvidia's share price, hyperscalers are quietly buying different chips for different jobs. Counting accelerators misses the real money, and a memory-stack model shows why the chip tally can mislead.

items.title: Stock Market Today, Nov. 20: Stocks Plunge as AI Trade Unwinds
items.summary: Wall Street's worst stretch of the year deepened as AI-linked names sold off while defensive sectors drew buyers, today, Nov. 20, 2026.

items.title: Tech sees huge sell-off as Anthropic IPO fails to lift the market
items.summary:
Deirdre Bosa discusses the AI trade falling apart as Wall Street sees widespread losses, Anthropic's (ANT) debut failing to boost markets, and the state of cybersecurity.

'Deirdre Bosa Live' airs every day at 4 p.m. Tune in daily to hear how the latest developments in AI and technology are reshaping companies, industries, and the global economy.

items.title: Jevons paradox and AI: Data shows usage soars as prices plunge
items.summary: Factory co-founder and CTO Eno Reyes joins Yahoo Finance's Deirdre Bosa to discuss whether token usage will keep rising as agent adoption deepens after OpenRouter data showed AI model pricing down 57% since January and usage up as spending flattened in recent weeks.

items.title: New AI Releases Help Google Avoid Worst of Tech Rout
items.summary: Few were spared in Friday’s tech rout, but Alphabet shares held up better than its Silicon Valley peers.

items.title: Nvidia’s Stock Slide Deepens After Report of SEC Accounting Probe
items.summary: The stock fell Friday and closed lower for a seventh-consecutive trading session.
